title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the commit plan items parse out of protocol.ts into protocol-commit-items.ts (#25467 cut 32)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2hxhTGwfufb41w8DfLVVBp)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 `protocol.ts` 里一个只有 10 行的私有方法 `parseCommitItems`（把提交记录的 `items` 列读回成回滚计划）原样搬进新文件 `protocol-commit-items.ts`，类上的方法保留并直接调用它。
- 为什么改：#25467 拆分超大文件 `protocol.ts` 的第 32 刀，按裁决只搬不改，让这个文件继续变小、好读。
- 风险与回滚：极低。逻辑逐 token 相同，发布的 `.d.ts` 原始字节两端完全相同，包测试 21,800 条逐条一致；回滚就是还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `parseCommitItems` 方法体（现在只剩一行调用）与 `CommitPlanItem` 前新增的 `export`；再看新文件 `protocol-commit-items.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.recovery-doors-emit-mutation.test.ts`，预期全部通过（它经 `revertCommit` 读回提交计划）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 32 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–31 landed; cut 31 is #27181. The claim is `6487683544`. It takes the cut 32 proposal of the cut 31 report (`6465513012`): one member on its own. It passed the AST screen and the read-seam census and moved unedited.

One `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` member moves unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-commit-items.ts` (#23050 shape B): `parseCommitItems`, which reads a stored `sys_metadata_commit` row's `items` column back as its revert plan. An array is the plan as stored; a string is parsed as JSON; anything else, or a string that is not a JSON array, reads as no items.

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parseCommitItems` | `:26479` | private, return type declared (`CommitPlanItem[]`) | 10 | 73 | no class member; module-level type `CommitPlanItem` |

- **The class keeps the member**: name, signature and position. It has no docblock. Its body is now one call, `return parseCommitItems(raw);`, marked `[#25467 cut 32]`.
- **No host.** The body reads no class member (no `this`), so the stub calls the plain function directly, as cut 26 did for `orgWallEnforced`.
- **Every caller still calls the class method**: `listCommits` (`this.parseCommitItems(r.items)`, base `:26577`) and `revertCommit` (`this.parseCommitItems(row.items)`, base `:26693`). Neither changes.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- `protocol.ts` goes from 29,514 to 29,508 lines. `protocol-commit-items.ts` has 44 lines. The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-xbievt` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread; it names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `dda5102340` on `main` `c4c515ad3c`, one merge of `main` `9b33088b78` (4 commits up to `7e200b4a68`, none in `packages/metadata-protocol/`), and `a09398108f`, a comment-only fix to the new module's header (it named the caller `listPackageCommits`; the method is `listCommits`).

### One top-level edit beyond the move: `CommitPlanItem` gains `export`

The dispatch's correction holds: `CommitPlanItem` is **not an import**. It is `protocol.ts`'s own non-exported module-level type alias (base `:2751`). The moved function's signature and body name it, so it gains the `export` keyword in place, with nothing else in its statement changed, and the new module imports it with `import type`. This follows `addressPackages` (cut 16), `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` (cut 23) and `noPendingDraftError` (cut 31).

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts` names its re-exports from `./protocol.js` one by one and does not name it, so the published surface does not move: the `.d.ts` and export-table readings below are identical at both ends.
- It keeps its other readers in `protocol.ts` (the `commitItems` plan built at publish, the commit-write argument type, both callers' results) and stays there.

## Tests

Nothing is added or changed under test; the cut is move-only. The package suite is compared per test at both ends (see Verification). The member is driven end to end through `revertCommit` by the recovery-door suites (`protocol.recovery-doors-*.test.ts`, `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts`), which serve `sys_metadata_commit` rows from a fake driver, and through `listCommits` by the commit-timeline suites (`protocol-14038-list-commits-created-at-iso.test.ts`, `protocol.commit-timeline-instant-order.test.ts`); all pass at both ends.

## Acceptance notes

- **The order's screen.** No private-static read and no `this.constructor` read (the body has no `this` at all). No `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. The body's `try`/`catch` guards `JSON.parse`, not a storage read, so it is outside the read-seam rule's vocabulary; the census does not move (below).
- **The cut 25 docblock-offset trap did not fire.** The raw `.d.ts` is byte-identical at both ends after the final byte layout, measured again after the comment-only commit.
- **Readers of the moved lines: none by path.** Grepped `parseCommitItems` and `CommitPlanItem` across the repository at `HEAD` (outside the two touched files): 0 hits. Of the 32 files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`, none names the member or its body text; three name `sys_metadata_commit` only as behavioural fixtures run through the protocol. No `@objectstack/spec` liveness row and no `docs/qa/platform-checklist` anchor names the member.
- **Liveness ledger follow-up, carried forward** (`packages/spec/**`, outside this card): `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19) and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). No row points at this cut's member.
- **Serial with in-flight PRs.** At `pr_create`, of the 23 open PRs none edits `protocol.ts` or names the member. The only one touching `packages/metadata-protocol/` is #26517 (Version Packages: `CHANGELOG.md`, `package.json`). Probed in a throwaway bare clone with no merge driver, it conflicts with this head in exactly the 4 `ui/packages/*/package.json` files it already conflicts with on `main` `ad2c2869bb`; none is in this package. `main` moved one commit after the merge (`ad2c2869bb`, `plugin-grid`); `git merge-tree` of this head with it is clean, so `main` was not merged again.
- No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Verification

### Proof of move-only

The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters, the return type and the body, base `protocol.ts` at `c4c515ad3c` against the head module:

```
parseCommitItems: base tokens 73, head tokens 73, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
CLASS members base=304 head=304 order-same=true byte-identical=303 stub-leading+signature-identical=true other=[]
TOP base=266 head=267 byte-identical=264 (class statement excluded)
TOP base-only: ["type CommitPlanItem = { type: string; name: string; existedBefore: boolean; prevVersion: number | null; member?: string };"]
TOP head-only: ["import { parseCommitItems } from './protocol-commit-items.js';","export type CommitPlanItem = { type: string; name: string; existedBefore: boolean; prevVersion: number | null; member?: string };"]
```

Negative controls, one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module:

```
"typeof raw === 'string'"  -> "typeof raw === 'object'"   differ 1
"Array.isArray(p) ? p"     -> "Array.isArray(raw) ? p"    differ 1
```

- **Class side.** 304 members at both ends, same order; the 303 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included; the stub keeps its leading trivia and signature byte-identical.
- **Top level.** Of the 265 non-class base statements, 264 are byte-identical; the other is `CommitPlanItem`, whose only change is the added `export`. Head adds the module import (with its one-line `[#25467 cut 32]` comment).
- **Size.** +49 / −11 over 2 files, 60 changed lines (the cut 31 report's estimate was 40–70).

### The published `.d.ts` (ruling `6348891160`)

Base `c4c515ad3c` and head were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree (the closure built by a full `turbo run build`, 115/115). For the base build the package `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; afterwards `git status --porcelain` was empty and both touched blobs hashed equal to `HEAD`'s.

| Reading | Base `c4c515ad3c` | Head `a09398108f` |
|---|---|---|
| raw sha256 `dist/index.d.ts` = `dist/index.d.cts` | `4cb92b2e20135dd78d07fd2800b1d2a050a432b923cd511d5b50f3ed6de29a58` (784,960 bytes) | same |
| normalised sha256 | `a4dcc2306638c29983bceaf7258df71a29a3020a3ec26904c9830a0cecd0c70e` | same |
| raw-diff lines | 0 | |
| `index.js` / `index.cjs` sha256 (16) | `20239680cb0cf515` / `f3ac1e9bdd5b9e96` | `e5abe0490663649f` / `1c36338d33aa16a5` |
| `function parseCommitItems(` in each bundle | 0 | 1 |
| export tables, ESM and CJS (sorted names + newline) | 78 names, `e47ac7c753bcb8be` | same; neither `parseCommitItems` nor `CommitPlanItem` |

**Both identities hold: raw and sorted-union.** The head reading was taken on the move commit, on the merged tree and again on `a09398108f`; all give the same hashes.

Normaliser, verbatim:

```
node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum
```

**Positive control** on the head tree: `private` dropped from `parseCommitItems` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to raw `ca90763579860f2c…` (785,652 bytes), normalised `b7639852d59f8343…` (differs from the bar's `a4dcc230…`), printing `parseCommitItems(raw: unknown): CommitPlanItem[];`. So the bar can see a change on this member.

### Gates and suites

<details><summary>Package suite, tsc, eslint</summary>

- `packages/metadata-protocol` suite, vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, under the shared verify lock. Base `c4c515ad3c` (src swapped tree-only, restored from `HEAD` under a trap), the move commit `dda5102340` and the final head `a09398108f`: all three 21,800 tests (21,774 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 283 files. Per test name and status over 21,787 distinct names: 0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed.
- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol`: exit 0, no output.

</details>

<details><summary>Hand gates, base and head</summary>

Base readings in a clean detached worktree at `c4c515ad3c`; head in the branch checkout.

- `check-durability-degradation-log-level`: exit 0 at both ends, output identical, `89 read seam(s)`. `--list` identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (165 lines); no entry changes file. 89 is the claim's base.
- Identical output, exit 0 at both ends: `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet` (50 unswept non-test sites in 15 files), `check-filter-alias-parity`.
- `check-nul-bytes`: exit 0 at both ends; scanned files +1 (the new module).
- `check-engine-double-contract`: exit 0 at both ends; the `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13997 → 13999 and 14022 → 14024: the import's two lines sit above them, and the move's eight removed lines below); `productionFiles` 3,876 → 3,878 (the new file and the gitignored spec `registry.ts` the build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–31).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 32 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-xbievt`: 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), NOT governed; 60 changed lines, under the 3,000-line bar.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `a09398108f` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths (merge base `7e200b4a6`). All 46 exit 0 after a full `turbo run build` (115/115). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.

On the final head the hand gates were re-read: `check-adr-anchors` output is identical to `main` `7e200b4a68`'s (60,467 citations, 1,900 decision letters; the +1 citation and file against `c4c515ad3c` come from the merged `main` commits), and `check-durability-degradation-log-level` is identical to base, `--list` included.

</details>
